tagline.en: Moldova's largest carrier — a €0.4/year-to-keep EU-adjacent number, no ID required
tagline.zh: 摩尔多瓦最大运营商——年保号成本约0.4元人民币的号码，无需实名

description.en: Moldtelecom is Moldova's oldest and largest telecom operator. Its eSIM (activation now handled inside the My Moldtelecom app; pricing no longer shown on the public page — 40 MDL per the 2025-09 review) ships a Moldovan number that roams in mainland China with free SMS receiving for 6 months plus a 6-month grace period. Keep the number alive with a 1 MDL top-up every 6 months — roughly ¥0.82/year (per the 2025-09 review; not stated on the current landing page). No real-name registration; Visa/Mastercard payment.
description.zh: Moldtelecom 是摩尔多瓦历史最悠久、规模最大的电信运营商。其eSIM自带摩尔多瓦号码（激活流程已迁入 My Moldtelecom App，公开页不再展示价格——2025-09口径为40列伊），中国大陆漫游可免费收短信；开通后6个月有效期+6个月宽限期。每6个月充值1 MDL即可保号，一年约2 MDL（约0.82元人民币）（2025-09实测口径，现行公开页未再标注）。无需实名，支持Visa/Mastercard支付。

details.en:
Moldtelecom's eSIM is the cheapest documented keep-alive number in this catalogue: the entry eSIM plan cost 40 MDL (~¥17.35) at the 2025-09 review — since then pricing has moved in-app and the public landing page shows no price; activation now runs inside the My Moldtelecom app (open app → verify device → Activare → email code → pick number → pay → QR by email), and the number works in mainland China right after activation — receiving SMS is free, though calls and outgoing SMS are not supported on the default balance (further top-up required even to test).

Validity: 6 months after activation plus a 6-month grace period during which the number can still receive SMS and dial special numbers (200/300/700) and 112; after the grace period the number is recycled.

Keep-alive: 1 MDL minimum top-up every 6 months — about ¥0.82 per year, the lowest recurring cost reviewed on this site (per the 2025-09 review; the current esimplu landing page no longer states validity terms, which now live in the app/FAQ).

Purchase flow (2025-09 source review; flow now app-first per the 2026-09-16 landing page — steps live inside the My Moldtelecom app, QR single-use with no expiry): verify by email code, choose a number (with an 'other numbers' reshuffle option), skip optional add-on packs, pay by card; three emails arrive (invoice, number info, eSIM QR code). Works on native-eSIM phones via the QR code, or via eSIM-chip readers like Xesim on ordinary phones.

Caveats: no calls/outgoing SMS in China roaming per the source test; Moldova is outside the EU so this is not an EU number for regulatory purposes; and the storefront is Moldovan — expect a mostly non-English checkout.
details.zh:
Moldtelecom的eSIM是本目录中保号成本最低的号码：入门套餐2025-09口径为40 MDL（约17.35元）——此后价格迁入App、公开落地页不再展示；激活流程也改为在 My Moldtelecom App 内完成（打开App→验证设备→Activare→邮箱验证码→选号→支付→二维码发邮箱），Visa/Mastercard支付，激活后在中国大陆即有漫游信号——收短信免费，但默认余额下不支持接打电话和发短信（需充值更多余额才能测试）。

有效期：激活后6个月+6个月宽限期（宽限期内仍可收短信、接听电话、拨打200/300/700等Moldtelecom业务号码和紧急电话112），宽限期后号码收回。

保号：每6个月最低充值1 MDL——一年约2 MDL（约0.82元人民币），是本站盘点过的最低持有成本（2025-09实测口径；现行esimplu落地页未再标注有效期条款，相关规则移入App/FAQ）。

购买流程（2025-09源测评；2026-09-16落地页确认流程已改为App优先——步骤在 My Moldtelecom App 内完成，二维码一次性使用、无过期时间）：邮箱验证码验证、挑选号码（可点other numbers换一批）、附加资源包无需选、刷卡支付；

约一分钟激活完成，收到账单/号码信息/eSIM二维码三封邮件。原生eSIM手机直接扫码，普通手机可用Xesim等eSIM芯片写入。

注意：源实测中国漫游不能通话和发短信；摩尔多瓦非欧盟，号码不具欧盟属性；官网界面以摩尔多瓦语为主。

bestFor.en: Extreme-budget keep-alive users: a working roaming number in China for under ¥1/year after entry.
bestFor.zh: 极限保号党：入门后每年不到1元人民币即可维持一个中国可漫游的号码。
